# Fairwall AI

> Fairwall AI is a local privacy layer for AI use. It detects sensitive data on the user's own device and redacts it before a prompt reaches a cloud AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others), then restores the real values in the reply. Nothing sent. Nothing stored. Nothing risked.

Fairwall AI is a brand and product of Data Dynamics AI FlexCo, Biraghigasse 33, 1130 Vienna, Austria. Contact: juan@ddynamics.ai.

## What it does
- Detects names, emails, phone numbers, national IDs, financial figures, addresses, secrets and API keys as they are typed.
- Redaction is reversible: placeholders are mapped locally, and the real values are restored in the AI reply.
- Every protection event is logged with a forensic ID, timestamp and latency figure, searchable and downloadable.
- Typical latency overhead: ~68ms. A 100% local / air-gapped option is available.
- Built for GDPR, HIPAA and PCI-DSS workflows. EU-based company, EU data residency.

## How it is deployed
- Browser plug-in — covers every AI tool used in the browser, automatically.
- Desktop app and proxy layer — covers local applications and all data and media types.
- n8n nodes — purpose-built integration for automated AI workflows.

## Pricing
- Individuals: from €8.50/month (Basic), €10 (Medium), €12 (Advanced). 30% off billed yearly. 15-day free trial.
- Corporates and AI agencies: quoted per rollout, scoped in a demo call.

- [Shadow AI: why most AI use at work is invisible](https://www.fairwall.ai/shadow-ai.html): why blocking fails and device-level protection works.
- [How to stop staff pasting client data into AI tools](https://www.fairwall.ai/stop-data-leaks-ai.html): a five-step operational approach.
- [Reversible PII redaction, explained](https://www.fairwall.ai/pii-redaction-explained.html): the token substitution and local restore mechanism.
- [Who is liable when a client's data reaches a model?](https://www.fairwall.ai/ai-privacy-for-agencies.html): processor obligations for AI agencies.
